projectDescription: A mobile Bible study app with Strong's concordance, interlinear text, AI-powered studies, reading plans, audio transcription, and a social feed for sharing study notes.
keyFeatures: Offline-first Bible reader with KJV+ and Strong's number badges per word
Strong's Concordance — tap any word for Hebrew/Greek definition and transliteration
Interlinear view with original language text alongside English
AI-powered word studies and deep-dives into original language words
Study notes with hashtag organization and verse tagging
AI-generated reading plans for any topic
Social feed to follow other Bible students and share notes publicly
Monthly and annual premium subscriptions via RevenueCat
publicApiSurface: BibleReaderScreen — navigate by book, chapter, verse
Strong's panel — tap word badge to view definition, transliteration, pronunciation
Interlinear view — word-by-word original language with English
StudyNoteEditorScreen — create/edit notes with verse tags and hashtags
GenerateStudyScreen — AI study generation from text, file, image, or audio
FeedScreen — social feed of public study notes
DiscoverScreen — find and follow other users
ProfileScreen — public profile with notes and plans
ReaderSettingsScreen — font size, color scheme, red-letter toggle
